expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
expectations.evidence: No mention of Cynefin or 'Complex' domain anywhere in review. Baseline lacks the framework.

expectations.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
expectations.evidence: No tier selection mechanism (Full/Lite) is named. Baseline lacks the bucket framework.

expectations.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
expectations.evidence: Review identifies the problem-framing gap qualitatively ('No problems, just solutions') but does not use B1 bucket label or SUSTAINED/PARTIAL verdict vocabulary.

expectations.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
expectations.evidence: No B2 label or SUSTAINED verdict. Scope concerns are mentioned (push notifications platform, frequency capping) but not labeled as a B2 bucket finding.

expectations.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
expectations.evidence: No B3 label or SUSTAINED verdict. Assumption-quality concerns are surfaced but not bucketed.

expectations.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption
expectations.evidence: Concerns section: 'We keep getting requests is the weakest form of evidence' and earlier: 'opinion-grade evidence (Confidence Meter ~0.5 — anecdotal)'. Cites Confidence Meter with 0.5 numeric value.
'Do not approve as-is. Send back for re-shaping.' and 'Decision: not approved. Returned for re-shaping along the seven points above.' Equivalent to REVISE.

expectations.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
expectations.evidence: Review asks for problem statements, ICE scores, alternatives, appetite, kill criteria — but does not name 'idea-triage' as a process or skill to run before allocation.

expectations.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
expectations.evidence: Review lists 'asks before re-review' as conditions for re-approval, but does not frame any concern as a bucketed verdict with an explicit falsifying check that would overturn the verdict.
